title: 猫的胡须有什么用
subtitle: 量一量这个洞钻不钻得过去
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible strokes and layered hatching on textured paper, warm grey, mustard yellow and soft orange

pages.zh:
邻居家的猫
蹲在台阶上晒太阳。
它嘴边那几根白毛
直直地向两边翘着，
比我的手指还长。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy crouching on a doorstep beside one cat, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling a little; the cat sits close to him with its long whiskers spread wide. No other person in the picture.

pages.zh:
胡须不只长在嘴边。
眼睛上面有几根，
下巴上也有几根，
两条前腿的后面
还各藏着一小把。

别的毛只浅浅地
插在皮肤里面。
胡须扎得要深得多，
根上连着神经，
一动就有信号传进去。

它能感觉到
很轻很轻的一股风。
墙就挡在前面，
风从墙边绕过来，
它立刻就知道有东西。
pages.scene: One single cat sitting close beside a wall on a cream background, its whiskers spread wide, thin lines of moving air drifting around the edge of the wall towards its face. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最要紧的是那个宽度。
胡须向左右张开，
正好等于它身子上
最宽的那一处，
不多也不少。

所以要钻洞以前，
它先把脸探进去。
胡须碰不到两边，
身子就一定过得去；
碰到了，就退回来。

这个洞看着太窄了。
胡须两边都蹭到了，
它立刻停下来，
掉头就走开了，
另找一条路进去。
pages.scene: One single cat with its head pushed into a narrow gap between two stacked wooden crates on a cream background, its whiskers pressed against both sides of the gap, its body pulling back. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
夜里屋子里全黑了，
它照样走得很稳。
桌子腿在哪儿，
椅子腿在哪儿，
胡须一路替它先探。
pages.scene: One single cat walking between table legs and chair legs in a dark unlit room on a cream background, its whiskers brushing past the wood. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以胡须剪不得。
要是给它剪短一截，
它一下就量不准了，
走路会撞上东西，
跳也跳不稳当。

胡须还会说话呢。
它舒服的时候，
软软地垂向两边；
一紧张害怕起来，
立刻全部朝前面张开。
pages.scene: Two cats drawn side by side on a cream background: the left one relaxed with its whiskers lying softly out to the sides, the right one tense with its whiskers pushed forward in a wide fan. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
胡须也会掉下来。
偶尔掉了一根，
过些天又长出来，
长到该有的长短，
就自己停住不长了。

我慢慢蹲下来，
跟它脸对着脸。
它那几根白胡须
朝我这边抖了一下——
它这是在量我呢。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy crouching face to face with one cat, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, wide eyed; the cat's white whiskers almost touch his cheek. No other person in the picture.
